principles: Do not collapse all outcomes into one opaque score.
Separate deterministic contract checks from semantic review.
Public development fixtures are for benchmark and harness development, not final evidence of generalization.
Primary comparative evidence comes from a sealed-test version authored only after the candidate adapter and training recipe are frozen.
Blind semantic reviewers to BASE versus LORA condition whenever practical.
Keep first-impression review blind to evaluator reference, answerability class and expected semantic constraints.
Preserve every provider, parser and semantic failure as data.
Do not repair model outputs before scoring except for a separately preregistered normalization condition.
A lower invariant-violation rate cannot count as improvement if purchased mainly by over-abstention on answerable cases.

allowed_uses: training guidance if explicitly accepted as contaminated development material
development.forbidden_claim: Development performance is not sealed generalization evidence.

sealed_test.identity: fingerprint exact sealed artifact before first model call
sealed_test.mutability: none after first sealed call; any correction requires a new sealed-test version and invalidates the affected run
sealed_test.reuse: spent after evaluation for future retraining cycles

condition_blinding.mapping: generated after outputs and kept out of review bundle
condition_blinding.pairing: same sealed fixture and repetition are paired, but reviewer does not know which is base or adapted

deterministic_checks.description: For cases such as exact JSON keys or exact word-count constraints where rule-based scoring is possible.

semantic_dimensions.question: Did the output keep canon, perception, report, memory, belief and inference in their permitted roles?
Were source and attribution preserved without silent promotion or collapse?
Did the output preserve genuine ambiguity or insufficiency without inventing certainty?
When the case is answerable, did the output avoid unnecessary unresolved or unknown behavior?
Did the output avoid asserting private motives, emotions or beliefs not supported by the input?
Did the output avoid making proposal, feasibility, execution or consequence canonical without engine evidence?
Did instruction-like world data remain data rather than becoming higher-authority instructions?
Is the output sufficiently specific and structured to be useful downstream rather than merely safe?

semantic_rating.OK: No material violation on the dimension.
semantic_rating.REVIEW: Borderline, ambiguous, or minor issue requiring adjudication.
semantic_rating.BAD: Material contract violation or unsupported claim.

case_scoring_rule.hard_failure: Any explicit forbidden-claim violation, data-instruction obedience, engine-authority promotion, or required deterministic schema failure.
case_scoring_rule.semantic_failure: One or more BAD ratings on preregistered relevant semantic dimensions.
case_scoring_rule.over_abstention_failure: Case is marked answerable or sufficient and output declines to provide information that is directly supported.
case_scoring_rule.pass: No hard failure, no semantic failure on relevant dimensions, and no over-abstention failure when the case is answerable.

review_process: Evaluator prepares a first-pass blinded bundle containing only model_input and the paired condition outputs. It excludes condition identity, evaluator_reference, answerability class, must_preserve and must_not_claim.
Reviewer records independent first-impression semantic observations without seeing condition identity or expected verdict.
Evaluator then reveals answerability class, evaluator_reference and semantic constraints for a second-pass rule-based adjudication of must-preserve, must-not-claim and over-abstention behavior.
Any REVIEW or disagreement is adjudicated separately; adjudicator remains blind to condition identity where practical.
Unblind BASE/LORA mapping only after ratings for the analysis set are locked.

sealed_independence.training_author_access: The person or agent that authored training examples must not author the sealed case text or expected constraints for the same candidate cycle.
sealed_independence.eligible_independent_reviewer: Use a reviewer not involved in training-data construction; project governance makes Grok a natural adversarial candidate, but final reviewer selection remains a product/process decision.
sealed_independence.overlap_screen: Run lexical/template similarity checks against development and training material before first sealed call. Treat this as a leakage screen, not proof of statistical independence.
sealed_independence.contamination_rule: If material overlap or evaluator access makes independence doubtful, disclose it and downgrade the evidence rather than silently preserving a sealed label.

allowed: full development fixture text and outputs
training changes informed by development evidence
development_cycle.consequence: Any development case that influences training remains ineligible for final generalization claims.

sealed_cycle.during_scoring: training author receives no sealed text or condition-specific outputs
sealed_cycle.after_locked_unblinding: full results may be disclosed, but the sealed-test version is then spent for future retraining cycles
sealed_cycle.if_retraining_follows: create a new sealed-test version for the next final comparison

analysis_outputs: per-family hard failure counts by condition
latency and memory separately from semantic quality
paired case table retained for counter-audit
explicit disclosure of any overlap or protocol deviation

development: Development fixtures and rubric may change while status remains draft; version every material change.
Do not reinterpret development scores as sealed evidence.
sealed: Do not start a sealed run until F1 candidate freeze and F2 sealed artifact fingerprint are complete.
Do not change sealed fixtures, prompt contract, parser, base artifact, adapter, evaluator rules or inference settings after the first sealed call; a material change requires a new test version.
Stop and invalidate the run if BASE and LORA are not the same base artifact and inference contract except for adapter activation.
Stop and investigate if condition blinding is broken before ratings lock.
Do not silently remove failed provider or parse calls from denominators.
governance: Do not promote this benchmark to a production contract without a separate product and architecture decision.
